name: factory-implement
title_zh: 认领一个 GitHub issue 并自动实现到可审
tagline_zh: 从 issue 到 draft PR 全自动：认领、改码、跑门禁、找独立验证。适合维护者批量清积压。
tagline_en: From issue to draft PR automatically: claim, code, run fail-closed gates, get independent verification. Perfect.
desc_en: Claim and implement one ready GitHub issue, run fail-closed gates, obtain independent verification, and open a draft pull request.
why_zh: 内置 fail-closed 门禁和独立验证环节，不是闷头改完就交差，而是先证明改动通过检查再开 PR。
why_en: Built-in fail-closed gates and independent verification ensure changes are proven before PR, cutting review cycles.
limit_zh: 只认 GitHub 上状态清晰、描述完整的 issue；需要本机配好 Node.js 和 git 凭据。
limit_en: Only for well-defined GitHub issues; requires Node.js and git credentials locally; not for large refactors; output is a draft PR, not merged code.
